facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: gravity release during start-up after maintenance on HT-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9001 and HT-9006 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9001 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 10 October 2024 an incident occurred on HT-9001 and HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
